syllabus: A writ of error to a state court is dismissed because no question was decided by that court of which this court has jurisdiction under the 25th section of the Judiciary Act.'
summary:
ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA.

The case is stated in the opinion.
attorneys: Mr. Lorenzo Allis for plaintiff in error., Mr. James Smith, Jr., for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Chase
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Chase

delivered the opinion of the court.

On looking into the record we do not find that any question was decided in the state court of which we have jurisdiction under the 25th section of the Judiciary Act. TKe writ of error therefore must be Dismissed.
